notes.2-3: both apply to a speaker: 'the salesman softened his pitch' can be his sales talk or the tone of his voice

notes.0-4: 'she changed her pitch when the buyer hesitated' can be her tone of voice or her persuasive speech
notes.1-2: both live in a game context: 'the pitch was rough' / 'studied the pitch' can be read as the playing field or the delivery of the ball (cricket uses pitch for both the strip and where the ball lands)
both are a raised mass by water: 'across the river a dark bank rose' can be a cloud or fog bank or the far riverbank
